title: LV service connection - 14 Wattle Grove, Parramatta
notes: Scripted pre-job briefing. Live LV work is discussed with PPE only (no isolation, earthing or test-before-touch), so the verifier should raise a blocking gap. Includes an off-topic footy exchange, a filler line and a phone number for PII redaction.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Righto, morning all. Sam here, I'm leading hand today. Let's run through the tailboard before we get stuck in.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Job is a new LV service connection off pole 4471 out the front of 14 Wattle Grove, Parramatta. Work order is WO-2026-118843.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: Priya here. The customer's new switchboard has been inspected and the certificate of compliance is on site, I've sighted it.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Task steps. Set up the site, get the EWP in position, run the new service main from the pole to the point of attachment on the house, then terminate at the pole top and at the house.

lines.speaker: u-crew-3
lines.text: It's Jack. I'll be up in the bucket doing the pole top connection, and Priya's on the ground as safety observer.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Main hazard is the LV mains on the pole. They're live, we're not getting an outage for this one.

lines.speaker: u-crew-3
lines.text: Yeah so I'll be working on live LV at the pole top. I'll have my arc flash gear on with the face shield and my insulated gloves.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Working at heights in the EWP. Harness on and clipped in the whole time, and do your EWP pre-start checks before you go up.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: Pre-start's done, the EWP is all good and the logbook's signed.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: There's overhead lines all along the street as well, so watch your approach distances when you're slewing the boom. Priya, you're spotting for that.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: Traffic. It's a narrow street with cars parked both sides. We'll put out cones and signs and set up an exclusion zone around the truck. Don't need traffic controllers.

lines.speaker: u-crew-3
lines.text: Anyone catch the footy on the weekend? Can't believe the Eels dropped another one.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: Don't get me started, mate. Shocking second half.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Alright, back on track. Weather's fine, wind's under twenty k's so we're right for the bucket. If it gets up over forty we bring it down.

lines.speaker: u-crew-3
lines.text: Ground's still soft from the rain last night, so I'll put the outrigger pads down before we set up.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: There's a dog in the backyard next door. I've asked the owner to keep it inside while we're working.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Dropped objects. Nobody stands under the bucket, tools on lanyards, and keep pedestrians out of the exclusion zone.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: Manual handling with the cable drum. We'll use the drum trailer and do a two person lift for anything heavy.

lines.speaker: u-crew-3
lines.text: Um, yeah.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: After the connection we do the polarity and neutral integrity tests before we energise the customer's installation. Priya, you're on testing.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: Yep, I've got the tester, it's in calibration and I checked it on a known source this morning.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Emergency. Muster point is the corner of Wattle Grove and Banksia Street, by the bus stop.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: Nearest hospital is Westmead Hospital, about ten minutes away. I'm the first aider and the kit's in the truck.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Comms will be on the radios, and if you can't raise me my mobile's 0412 345 678.

lines.speaker: u-crew-3
lines.text: EWP rescue kit is on the truck, and Priya knows the ground controls if she needs to bring me down.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Any other hazards anyone wants to raise? Anything we've missed?

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: Just the asbestos sticker on the old meter box, so we're not touching the meter panel at all.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Good catch. Leave the meter panel alone, the metering crew will sort that out.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Right, everyone happy with that? Sign on and let's get into it.

lines.speaker: u-crew-3
lines.text: Happy with that.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: All good.
